name: Controlify
author: isXander
curator_note: Full controller support for Minecraft, which ships with none: gamepad-driven menus, radial item wheels, rumble, gyro aiming, and per-controller binds. Agora offers this mod by name when it sees a controller in use, so the same jar the launcher suggests is the one curated here. Needs YetAnotherConfigLib (installed automatically as a dependency); Fabric and NeoForge ship from one universal jar.
